notes.title: ~*A LONG AWAITED UPDATE*~
notes.notes:
Hello there everyone, 

Well, it's been a minute hasn't it? This summer I've spent time planning and learning new tools and visiting family back home in Chicago. Sadly, it's taken me away from posting as many updates as I would like but no more I say. No more!

So, I'll get straight to the biscuits:

[olist]
    We've surpassed 54,000 downloads on Steam!
    I'll be speaking at Geek Girl Con this October! My first ever big old speaking engagement about mental health and video games.
    And the most exciting news of all (insert trumpet fanfare) Episode 2 of the Samantha Browne series is officially in the works!ːsteamhappyː
[/olist]
The second episode of the Samantha Browne series will be feature new characters and a much longer story. I don't want to give away too much, but I'm supremely excited and can't wait to provide you with more consistent updates on how Episode 2 is progressing. 

I hope all of you are well and I'm so sorry it's been so long since I said hello and gave you an update. Thank you again for your continued support and for your kindness.

As always,
Andrea 
@missafayres

notes.title: Good News Everyone: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey all,

First, thanks so much for your support and for playing the game! It means so much to me. I'm grateful to each of you for taking the time to share this game with friends, write reviews, and provide feedback.

Now to the fun bits...

Samantha's magically appearing sixth finger is no more. 
Made adjustments to 'Once More, With Feeling' achievement. Also, as a tip, the order of the fails is important. 

Thanks again for your continued support! 

Cheers-
Andrea

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Oh, Hello. 

How are you? Hopefully well.

Without much further ado, here's the latest and greatest: 

The Average Everyday Adventures of Samantha Browne is almost here and like time itself, there's nothing any of us can do to stop it. 
On April 19, 2016 you'll be able to download the game for free on these fine services: Steam, the Apple App Store, and itch.io.
The first 25 players to beat Samantha Browne while streaming will receive a physical gift you can hold and treasure for all your days, or for a month, it's really up to you. More details coming soon.
We have a smörgåsbord of fun planned so please check out Twitter and  Facebook for the latest news.


Cheers,
Andrea

notes.title: Preparing for Release
notes.notes:
As the countdown to release approaches we're getting everything ready for the final push. 

What does all of that actually mean? 

[olist]
    Engaging in some minor bug fixes, optimizing Windows experience
    Creating the launch trailer
    Making the swag (Yes, I am crafting it with my own two hands)
[/olist]

If you have any questions please feel free to send them my way by creating a discussion or shoot me a message on Twitter @missafayres ːsteamhappyː

Cheers-
Andrea & the rest of the Lemonsucker team
